# loading libraries
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(rio)
library(ggplot2)
library(psych)
library(ggthemes)
library(summarytools)
library(tidyr)
library(formatR)
library(sjmisc)
library(caret)
library(randomForest)
library(report)
```

# load inbuilit data
```{r}
data(iris)
head(iris)
```



# data structure
```{r}
str(iris)
```


# view data set
```{r}
View(iris)
```

# SET SEED: to ensure reproducibity
```{r}
set.seed(123)

```

# confirm missing values
```{r}
sum(is.na(iris))
colSums(is.na(iris))
```





# split data set
### train model
```{r}
train_iris<- sample(seq_len(nrow(iris)), size=.7*nrow(iris))
train_iris_data<- iris[train_iris, ]
test_iris<- iris[-train_iris, ]
```

### check dimension
```{r}
dim(train_iris_data)
dim(test_iris)
```

# head
```{r}
head(train_iris_data) # random data split
```


# train random forest classify model
```{r}
rf_model<- randomForest(
  
  formula =Species~.,
  data= train_iris_data,
  ntree=500,
  mtry=2,
  importance=TRUE,
  proximity = FALSE
             
)
```


## print model summary
```{r}
print(rf_model)
```

### predict on test set
```{r}
predictions<- predict(rf_model, newdata = test_iris)
head(predictions)
head(test_iris)
```

### model evaluation performanve
```{r}
conf_mat<- table(pridicted=predictions, actual= test_iris$Species)
print(conf_mat)

accuracy<- sum(diag(conf_mat))/ sum(conf_mat)
cat("test Accuracy:", round(accuracy, 4),"\n")
```


### variable importance
```{r}
cat(" \n variable importance(mean decrease in accuracy:\n")
print(importance(rf_model, type=1))
```




### variable importance
```{r}
varImpPlot(rf_model, main=" Random Forest variable importance")
```





### creating new data
```{r}
data=data.frame(Sepal.Length=c(4.6, 4.1),
                Sepal.Width= c(2.6, 3.5),
                Petal.Length=c(1.3, 1.4),
                Petal.Width=c(0.3, 0.4)
            
                )
head(data)
```



## predictoion on new data set
```{r}
predicted<-predict(rf_model, newdata=data)
head(predicted)
```
